fire: Sepak takraw is a game like volleyball played with the feet.
Hurling is an Irish sport like field hockey but faster.

Korfball is a team sport similar to netball.

Hurling is an Irish tradition that goes back centuries.
The hammer is one of the oldest tools in the shed.
Petanque players often meet in the town square.
Korfball teams have both men and women.
